target_user: Email strategists, consultants, and founders analyzing a prospect or client
business_outcome: Fetches a founder's public email archive, extracts voice and structure patterns, and drafts one sample campaign in their voice.
agent_tools: Web fetch, email archive scraper, file write
automation_hooks: Schedule as a pre-call research step; trigger on new deal creation
recommended_connections: Email archive (Mailchimp/Beehiiv/public URL); output destination (Drive or Docs)
approval_gates: Human approval before sharing the snapshot externally or sending any cold outreach derived from it.

target_user: Email strategists and consultants producing client-facing reports
business_outcome: Deep-dive analysis of opens, clicks, CTOR, subject line performance, and list growth — produces a branded PDF report.
agent_tools: ESP API or export, data analysis, PDF/doc generation
automation_hooks: Schedule as a monthly or quarterly reporting run
recommended_connections: ESP (ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, etc.); Drive or Docs for report delivery
approval_gates: Client or internal review before sharing report externally.

target_user: Email strategists auditing a prospect or client domain
business_outcome: Checks SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records for any domain and surfaces gaps that hurt deliverability.
automation_hooks: Run as part of onboarding audit; trigger on new client domain
recommended_connections: DNS resolver; optional reporting destination (Slack, Docs)
approval_gates: None required — read-only DNS check. Flag findings to client before recommending changes.

target_user: Founders and marketers reviewing landing pages or above-the-fold copy
business_outcome: Determines whether a page communicates what it offers within 10 seconds of landing — scores clarity and surfaces the top fix.
automation_hooks: Run as part of a pre-launch checklist or audit workflow
recommended_connections: Target URL; optional scoring rubric doc
approval_gates: Human review before sharing results with a client.

target_user: Founders and consultants running a formal positioning process
business_outcome: Runs the Obviously Awesome positioning canvas — competitive alternatives, unique attributes, target segment, value, and market category.
automation_hooks: Use as a workshop or async intake workflow
recommended_connections: Discovery notes or transcript; output destination (Docs or Notion)
approval_gates: Founder sign-off before the canvas is used in sales materials or shared externally.

target_user: Founders and copywriters pressure-testing an offer before launch
business_outcome: Reviews an offer through the Grand Slam Offer framework — dream outcome, perceived likelihood, time delay, effort/sacrifice — and flags the weakest levers.
automation_hooks: Run before any new offer goes live or before a sales page ships
recommended_connections: Offer description or copy draft; optional competitor examples
approval_gates: Human review before using scores or recommendations in external copy.

target_user: Founders and operators triaging task lists or routing work
business_outcome: Classifies tasks as judgment (needs a human), execution (can be delegated or automated), or mixed — so work lands in the right lane.
automation_hooks: Run on Asana/Todoist exports; trigger during weekly planning
recommended_connections: Task list source (Asana, Todoist, Notion, plain text)
approval_gates: Human review before rerouting or closing tasks based on classification.

target_user: Founders and consultants preparing for external calls
business_outcome: Generates a pre-meeting brief from calendar context, CRM notes, and public research — who they are, what they care about, what to ask.
agent_tools: Calendar API, CRM read, web research
automation_hooks: Schedule to run 1-2 hours before each external meeting
recommended_connections: Google Calendar or equivalent; CRM (HubSpot or similar); output channel (Slack or Docs)
approval_gates: None required for internal use. Flag if brief includes sensitive data before sharing with a third party.

target_user: Founders and operators doing a weekly review of their own leverage
business_outcome: Audits the last 7 days of work, surfaces repeated tasks, hidden overwhelm, and the highest-leverage systems to build next.
agent_tools: Work log or task history read, structured analysis
recommended_connections: Task history source (Asana, Todoist, daily log); output destination (Slack or Docs)
approval_gates: Human review before acting on build recommendations.

target_user: Email strategists and consultants running end-of-campaign reviews
business_outcome: Turns campaign data, team notes, and source docs into a concise retro: what happened, what worked, what broke, and what changes next.
agent_tools: Analytics read, document synthesis, structured output
automation_hooks: Run at campaign close or on a monthly cadence
recommended_connections: Analytics source (ESP, GA); campaign notes or brief; output destination (Docs)
approval_gates: Metric and stakeholder review before sharing retro externally.
